summary: End-to-end testing of the new delivery-fee-only coupon feature. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_coupons.py with 16 pytest tests covering admin CRUD (list-requires-auth, free_delivery create, percent create, missing-percent-value rejection, duplicate-code rejection, active toggle update, delete), and checkout integration (quote baseline, quote free_delivery, quote percent 50%, pickup rejection, unknown-code rejection, inactive-code rejection, session actually consuming used_count + max_uses enforcement at both /quote and /session after exhaustion, and two regression paths — delivery no-coupon + pickup no-coupon still return unchanged fees). ALL 16 backend tests passed. Frontend: verified via Playwright the full admin flow (login → nav 'Codes promo' via data-testid=admin-nav-coupons → create free_delivery + percent_off_delivery coupons, auto-uppercase, toggle active off/on, delete with confirm) and the customer checkout flow with a seeded cart (pickup+coupon shows exact French error, switching to delivery shows red 'Code UITEST_A -0.40 €' discount line reducing delivery fee to 0, remove button reverts to input, unknown coupon shows 'Code promo invalide.', percent_off_delivery coupon correctly shows -50% of delivery fee). No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: `_apply_coupon` correctly uses `find_one_and_update` with `{used_count: {$lt: max_uses}, active: true}` filter to atomically consume a use — race-safe as claimed. Verified serially via test_session_consumes_usage_and_max_uses_enforced. Non-blocking observation: the pre-check `if used_count >= max_uses` before the atomic step is redundant but harmless (nice fast-fail path).
`admin_update_coupon` on PUT with `code`: allows renaming to an already-existing code (no uniqueness check on rename, only on create). Minor edge case, low priority.
`admin_update_coupon`: if payload sets `discount_type=percent_off_delivery` without `percent_value`, no validation triggers on update path (only enforced on create). Minor edge case.
CouponsAdmin.jsx: the delete handler swallows API errors silently (no try/catch/toast). Low priority.

Checkout.jsx: applying an invalid coupon surfaces the error via `quote.error` in `data-testid=checkout-error`, but `canSubmit` does NOT check `!quote?.error`, so the submit button is not disabled — however the final `/checkout/session` will fail with the same 400 and a toast, so the flow is still safe (never places a discounted order under wrong assumptions). Consider disabling submit on quote error for cleaner UX. Low priority.
seed_data_creation: All test coupons (UITEST_A, UITEST_B and random TEST_* codes) and test orders ([TEST ORDER] notes) created by the backend + frontend tests were cleaned up via the admin DELETE endpoints in fixture teardown / at the end of the Playwright script. Verified no lingering UITEST_* rows remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The coupon feature is fully working and covered by /app/backend/tests/test_coupons.py (pytest, 16 tests, ~7s). Menu items require `line_id` + `item_id` fields (not `menu_item_id`) in the CartLine payload — noted here because it tripped up the initial test iteration. Checkout /session response returns only {order_id, order_number, payment_method}; to verify the persisted order fields you must GET /api/admin/orders/{id}. Frontend cart uses localStorage key `bt_cart_v1` which is the simplest way to seed a cart in Playwright without going through the interactive customization modals.
